scenes.heading: YOUR AGENT *SHOOTS THE AD*
scenes.sub: huashu-motion · a film crew in your terminal
scenes.say: Your coding agent can now shoot your product's launch film, music included.

scenes.heading: MEET *HUASHU-MOTION*
scenes.say: This is Huashu Motion, a skill that turns your agent into a one person film crew.

scenes.heading: THE *SHOOT*
steps: Writes the film and the score
scenes.say: It reads your product, writes the whole film and composes the score, then opens an editor where you point at any frame and it changes just that part.

scenes.heading: MAKERS *NOTICED*
scenes.say: Makers gave it over eight hundred stars on its first day.

scenes.heading: *ONE COMMAND*
scenes.say: One command adds it to the coding agent you already use.

scenes.heading: BEFORE THE *PREMIERE*
cons: Only tested on Mac so far
Needs Node, Chrome and FFmpeg set up
pros: Music composed locally, no paid APIs
scenes.say: The honest catch: it has only been tested on Mac so far, and your machine needs Node, Chrome and FFmpeg ready. In return, it is free and open source, and the music is composed locally with no paid services.
What would your agent film first? Comment Film and follow for tools like this.

youtube.title: Your Coding Agent Can Now Shoot Your Launch Film (huashu-motion)
youtube.description:
huashu-motion is an agent skill that turns Claude Code, Codex and other coding agents into a film crew: it reads your product, writes the launch film, composes the score locally, and lets you re-edit by pointing at a frame. 881 GitHub stars on day one. Catches are in the video: macOS-tested so far, and you need Node, Chrome and FFmpeg.
Source: https://github.com/alchaincyf/huashu-motion
